title: The Timer Over Their Heads — Part 1
series_premise: You're the only one who can see the timer over people's heads. Yours is the shortest.

style.look: 2D hand-drawn cartoon, bold dark outlines with line boil, flat colors, dark moody navy/purple/teal palette

characters.you: teen, messy black hair, pale skin, dark under-eyes, dark teal hoodie
characters.mom: brown bob, mauve cardigan, mug of coffee — timer 61 years
characters.dog: grey-brown mutt, floppy ears, red-free dark collar — timer 3 years
characters.stranger: man in dark beanie, grey coat, headphones — timer 4 minutes
characters.teacher: auburn bun, round glasses, dark green blazer — timer 6 days

narration.text: You woke up, and everyone had a timer over their head.
Then, on the bus, a stranger. Four minutes.
Nobody looked up. Only you reacted.
That night, you finally looked in the mirror.
Your timer was the shortest in the room.
And your reflection... moved a little late.
The next morning, your teacher turned around.
Same as yours. To the second.
Comment A to tell her, or B to follow her. The majority decides Part Two.

scenes.visual: Extreme close-up: your eyes snap open in a dark bedroom, red timer-glow on your face. Glitch + hit on frame 1.
View from your window: people on the street below, every one with a glowing timer.
Kitchen morning. Mom with coffee (61 YRS), dog on the floor (3 YRS).
scenes.camera: push to mom, pan to dog, pull back

scenes.visual: Bus interior, streetlights strobe past. Stranger with headphones: 00:04:00 racing down, then 3, 2, 1.
scenes.camera: slow push to stranger, shakes on 3-2-1

scenes.visual: Stranger slumped on the bus floor, timer 00:00:00 flickers out. Everyone still on phones.
Close-up: you, wide-eyed, the only one reacting.
Bathroom mirror. Mom and dog pass behind you in the reflection. Your timer: 6 DAYS. The mirror is off: the reflected timer reads the right way round, and the reflection tilts late and almost smiles.
scenes.camera: slow push to mirror, glitch on reveal

scenes.visual: Classroom, students with long timers. Teacher turns from the board: 6 DAYS.
scenes.camera: push to teacher, glitch + shake on reveal

scenes.visual: Split screen: teacher / you, both timers ticking in perfect sync.
Dark school hallway, teacher walking away, timer glowing. Cards: A = TELL HER, B = FOLLOW HER. 'Comment A or B — majority decides Part 2'.

cta.text: Comment A or B. The majority decides Part 2.

voice.voice_hint: calm, low, slightly uneasy male narrator
